datasets.name: Clothing Dataset for Second-Hand Fashion v3 — official author front-only RGB
datasets.publisher: Farrukh Nauman / RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB; Wargön Innovation AB; Myrorna AB
datasets.image_rightsholder: Original institutional data collectors RISE/Wargön/Myrorna, represented by the original depositor and original-author mirror
datasets.commercial_basis: Original Zenodo deposit explicitly licenses photographs/annotations CC BY 4.0 and identifies sorting-facility collection, not web scraping. Original depositor links his official front-only RGB Hub dataset and reiterates CC BY 4.0 and Zenodo attribution. Public download, no gated service/model terms. Scope: original-author front photos only, exclude brand closeups, no fabricated masks/seams or cm.
datasets.attribution: Nauman, F. (2024). Clothing Dataset for Second-Hand Fashion (Version 3) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13788681. RISE, Wargön Innovation and Myrorna. CC BY 4.0. Official front-only RGB conversion by Farrukh Nauman; Coordit category filtering, normalization and grouping.
datasets.approval_reason: Original-photo origin and CC BY 4.0 confirmed in original institutional deposit, original depositor project page and his official front-only mirror. Commercial training/modification allowed subject to attribution. Approval covers image rights, not nonexistent seam/mask/cm labels or release accuracy.
